name: Bias in the Picture
description: Bias in the Picture is a news-image benchmark consisting of 1,343 image-question pairs annotated with ground-truth answers and demographic attributes to evaluate social biases in vision-language models (VLMs). It uses LLM-as-Judge assessment with human verification to analyze bias prevalence and faithfulness in VLM outputs.
reputation: A very recent fairness benchmark that is still emerging and has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Includes demographic annotations and evaluation rubric; highlights bias risks in VLMs related to social attributes.
